title: Add payment tracking fields and enhanced data export

requirements.text: Add a payment status field to the Lead data model with three possible values: Pending, Paid, and Failed. Store this as an optional variant type in the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Lead type includes optional paymentStatus field with Pending/Paid/Failed variants
Existing leads without payment status remain valid (backward compatible)
Payment status can be queried and updated through backend methods

requirements.text: Add a notes field to the Lead data model for tracking payment conversations and general lead notes. Store as optional text field with no length restrictions.
acceptanceCriteria: Lead type includes optional notes field of type Text
Notes can be added and updated independently of other lead fields
Empty notes field does not affect existing lead operations

requirements.text: Update the LeadDetailDialog component to display and allow editing of the new payment status field. Show status as a dropdown selector with Pending/Paid/Failed options, with appropriate color coding (yellow for Pending, green for Paid, red for Failed).
acceptanceCriteria: Payment status appears in the lead detail view
Status can be changed via dropdown in edit mode
Status colors match: Pending (yellow), Paid (green), Failed (red)
Changes persist when dialog is saved

requirements.text: Update the LeadDetailDialog component to display and allow editing of the notes field. Show as a multi-line textarea with at least 4 rows of height.
acceptanceCriteria: Notes field appears in the lead detail dialog
Textarea allows multiple lines of text entry
Notes persist when dialog is saved
Empty notes display gracefully without errors

requirements.text: Include payment status and notes fields in all data export formats (CSV, Excel, PDF-ready HTML, RTF/DOCX). Add these as new columns in the leads section of exports.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV exports include PaymentStatus and Notes columns
Excel exports include PaymentStatus and Notes columns
PDF HTML exports include payment status and notes in lead tables
RTF/DOCX exports include payment status and notes fields
Empty values display as blank cells/fields rather than errors

requirements.text: Update the LeadCard component to display a payment status badge when present. Show badge with appropriate color and position it prominently alongside the existing status badge.
acceptanceCriteria: Payment status badge appears on lead cards when status is set
Badge colors match the status dropdown (Pending/yellow, Paid/green, Failed/red)
Badge does not appear for leads without payment status
Layout remains clean with both status and payment status visible

requirements.text: Add payment status as a filterable option on the LeadsPage. Include a payment status filter dropdown alongside existing status and niche filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Payment status filter dropdown appears on leads page
Filter includes All/Pending/Paid/Failed options
Filtering updates the displayed leads list
Filter works in combination with existing status and niche filters

constraints: Maintain backward compatibility with existing Lead records that do not have payment status or notes
Payment status must use variant types (not plain text) to ensure type safety
Do not modify the existing Payment entity structure - these fields belong to Lead records
Export functionality must handle missing/optional fields gracefully
nonGoals: Integration with external payment systems (Razorpay, PayPal, etc.)
Automated payment status updates from payment gateways
Financial reporting or revenue analytics for lead payment status
